<entry id="E00352">
<head-word>הִיזְמָא, </head-word>
<head-word>הוּזְ', </head-word>
<head-word>אִיזְמָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (הזם, cmp. חזם) 
<italic>a prickly shrub</italic>, prob. 
<italic>Spina Regia</italic> (v. Löw Aram. Pfl. p. 231 a. quot. ib. from Plin. Hist. Nat.).</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kil. I, 11 you must not plant 
<italic>cuscuta</italic> על גבי האי' ed. Zuck. (Var. אזמאזמא, corr. acc.) on 
<italic>izma</italic>.—
<plural-form>Pl. הִיזְמֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Job XXXI, 40 הז' (Ms. הוּ').—Keth. 77
<sup>b</sup> שכר של הי' beer containing (in place of hops) cuscuta growing on 
<italic>hizmé</italic>.—Mostly in connection with היגי, v. הֵיגְתָא. Sabb. 107
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>הִיזְמְתָא</head-word>

<notes> Erub. 28
<sup>b</sup> דקטלינן לה לה' וכ' for the cuscuta dies when the 
<italic>hizmé</italic> are cut.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00354">
<head-word>הֶיזֵּק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נזק) 
<italic>injury, damage, loss; danger</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 53
<sup>a,</sup> a. fr. ה' שאינו ניכר a damage not discernible in the object itself (e.g. if an unclean person touches food, whereby its value is reduced, because the scope of its use is limited). B. Kam. 2
<sup>b</sup> שן יש הנאה להֶיזֵּיקָהּ the damage done by the tooth is connected with a benefit (to the animal). Ib. רגל הזיקה מצוי the damage by the foot is an ordinary occurrence (and must be guarded against). Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>b</sup> top ה' חמין possible injury to health by the hot bath. Gen. R. s. 82 דבר של ה' an obnoxious thing (animal); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00360">
<head-word>הַיי</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (= הַאי) 
<italic>this, that</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> bot. ה' שיניך וכ' (Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> bot. האי) how is that tooth of thine?—[Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26
<sup>a</sup> היי די ליה אב, v. הַיְידָּא.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= הֵי) 
<italic>which?</italic> (generally with דֵּין or דָּא, v. 
<xref rid="E00363">הַיְידָּא</xref>, 
<xref rid="A00083">הַיְידֵּן)</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> אהיי דין … וה' דין וכ' (read היי) which wine was good for the bowels, and which &c.—Y. R. Hash. I, beg. 56
<sup>a</sup> ה' דין שני … וה' וכ' which 
<italic>sheni</italic> refers to months, and which to years?—Y. Meg. I, 72
<sup>a</sup> top ה' לין אינון וכ' (= ה' אילין; Y. Succ. III, 54
<sup>a</sup> top הַיְילֵין) which are the headings of chapters?—Y. Keth. VII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top [read:] כהיי דא מתניתא דר' חנין בשם ר' שמואל with which of them does the Boraitha cited by R. Ḥ. … agree?—Ib. IX, 32
<sup>d</sup> bot. [read:] היי לין רבנין (Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16
<sup>b</sup> מאן אינון) who are meant by ‘the Rabbis’?—With prefixes: כַּיי, לַיי. Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>a</sup> top כיי דמר ר' וכ' (= כהא דאמר) as (that which) R. … said. Y. Erub. III, 21
<sup>a</sup> top; a. fr.—Y. Shebu. II, 33
<sup>d</sup> (לַיְידָּא) ליי דא מילה with regard to what?; a. e.—Y. Gitt. IX, end, 50
<sup>d</sup> ואדיין את ליי (usually לזו), v. אֲדַיִין.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>; v.

<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00362">
<head-word>הַיָיא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> adv. (= חייא, cmp. חָיֹות, Ex. I, 19) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>quickly, rapidly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 84
<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 134
<sup>b</sup> סליק בישרא ה' (Ms. M. הַיָא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the flesh grows fast (the wound heals quickly). Ib. 119
<sup>a</sup> bot. דליקומי ה' that they may soon rise.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (an exclamation of encouragement) 
<italic>quick! go on!</italic> Gitt 34
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. 
<xref rid="A03274">אֲשׁוּר</xref>.</definition>
<notes>—Pes. 112
<sup>b</sup> (sailors’ cry) ה' ה' Ms. M. (ed. הילני ה' הילא והילוק הוליא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Mus. in Ar. ed. Koh.: הליוני ה' הילא הילוף). [Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>d</sup> ה' דהרין סבא ed. Amst., ed. Krot. חיוי, Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>c</sup> top חייא, read חַיֵּי.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00363">
<head-word>הַיְידָּא, </head-word>
<head-word>הַיְידָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= היי דא) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>this very thing, even this, it is this</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. I, 22
<sup>b</sup> top ה' מחלוקת this very thing is controverted. Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>c</sup> bot. ה' משום נטילת וכ' this is because it is an act of killing. Y. Taan. V, 67
<sup>d</sup> top וה' אמר and this he said.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= הֵי דָא) 
<italic>which? where?</italic> Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56
<sup>a</sup> top בה' אתיתא by which road did you come? Ib.</definition>
<notes> ולא חכים בה' and he did not know by which.—Y. Sabb. II, 5
<sup>a</sup> bot. ה' היא which (transgression) is it (that he is guilty of)? Ib. VII, 10
<sup>c</sup>, a. fr. וה' אמרה דא and what (Mishnah, Boraitha) says this (where is your authority)?; Y. Pes. II, 29
<sup>b</sup> bot. והַיְדָּא.—Contr. וַיְידָּא. Ib. VII, 34
<sup>b</sup> bot. ו' אמר and it is this he said; i.e. in this connection he said it.—לַיְידָּא, v. הַיי.—היידא ל־ (cmp. h. הִנֶּנּוּ) 
<italic>behold, there is</italic>. Y. Bicc. II, beg. 64
<sup>c</sup> והַיְידָּלֹון חמשים וכ' (= וה' לון) and behold, here are fifty two.—Gen. R. s. 84 (ref. to הַלָּזֶה, Gen. XXXVII, 19) הַיְידִּי ליה וכ' (= היידא הִי) behold, it is himself, he comes carrying his dreams; (Yalk. ib. 141 דיליה, corr. acc.).—Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26
<sup>a</sup> היי די ליה אב וכ' behold, he is a father and not a son.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00368">
<head-word>הַיְידֵּן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= היי דן, v. 
<xref rid="E00363">הַיְידָּא</xref>) 
<italic>which now? who?</italic> Y 
<pgbrk id="pg345" />Peah VIII, 21
<sup>a</sup> top ה' וינון (read יינון or אינון) which are they?; [Y.</definition>
<notes> Erub. III, 20
<sup>d</sup> top אילין אינון, read: אַיְילֵן].—Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> ה' ר' מאיר, v. הֵי II.—Y. Sabb. XIX, 17
<sup>b</sup> (also היי דין). Y. Gitt. II, 44
<sup>a</sup> bot. ה' הוא למחר what is meant by ‘to-morrow’ (the next following or the day after the next)?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00369">

<sup>c</sup> bot. ה' אמצעי which do you call ‘the central’? (v. הָהֵנוּ).</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. I, 27
<sup>d</sup> top היי ד' שעת הביעור which ‘time of removal’? Ib. V, 32
<sup>c</sup> top והַיְידֵּינוּ לשמו פטור and what case do you mean when saying 
<italic>lishmo patur?</italic>—Y. Yeb. IV, 6
<sup>b</sup> top הֵידֵינוּ רבה which is greater?—Y. Snh. V, 22
<sup>d</sup> top הידינו כולל וה' מונה what is meant by 
<italic>kolel</italic>, and what by 
<italic>moneh?</italic>; Y. Naz. III, 52
<sup>d</sup> bot. היי די נו (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00372">
<head-word>הַיְינוּ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (= הַיי נִיהוּ) 
<italic>it is this, it is he; it is the same, it corresponds to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 25
<sup>b</sup> bot. ה' דבעא וכ' it is this that R. J. asked. Pes. 50
<sup>a</sup> ה' דכתיב וכ' it corresponds to what is written &c., v. בִּשְׁלָמָא. Y. Ter. II, 41
<sup>b</sup> bot. וה' חמשה וכ' this is analogous to the case of ‘five sacks’ &c. Sabb. 118
<sup>b</sup> ה' ורדימס ה' וכ' Vardimas and Menahem are names of the same person; a. v. fr.—Ber. 2
<sup>b</sup> חכמים ה' ר' מאיר what difference is there between what ‘the scholars’ say and what R. M. says? Ib. ר' חנינא ה' ר' וכ'; a. fr.—[דְּהַיְינוּ 
<italic>which means</italic>. Gen. R. s. 87 (in a gloss) דה' בעליך viz. thy husband.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00374">
<head-word>הֵיךְ</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(= הֵי כְּ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>how?</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="E00333">הֵיאַךְ</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>b</sup> bot. ה' עבידא how can it happen?, i.e. name a case to which this rule will apply.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>as, like;</italic> in Targ. editions mostly with double comparison: הֵיךְ כְּ־.</definition>
<notes>—Targ. Ps. XXII, 15, sq.; a. v. fr.—ה'—ה' 
<italic>as</italic>—
<italic>so</italic>. Targ. Ps. CXXXIX, 12.—ה' מה 
<italic>as that which, even as</italic>. Targ. Y. II Num. XXIV, 1, v. infra.—ה' מה דאת אמר (abbr. המד"א) even as you read in the Scriptures. Gen. R. s. 1, beg.; a. v. fr.—Y. Succ. III, 54
<sup>a</sup> top ה' מה דאמרת וכ' the same words which you spoke to the one, you spoke to the other!—Combined הֵיכְמָא, הֵיכְמָה. Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 1; a. fr.—Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—As prefix to nouns הֵיכ־. Targ. I Chr. II, 54 היכנטופא (ed. Lag. הי כנ'). Ib. 55 (ed. Lag. הי כ־); v. הֵי II.—*[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="E00375">next w.</xref>) 
<italic>where?</italic> Targ. Ps. LXXXIX, 50 Ms. (ed. אָן).</definition>
<notes>]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00375">
<head-word>הֵיכָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= הֵי כָּא) 
<italic>where?</italic>, (relat.) 
<italic>where</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jer. III, 2 (ed. Lag. אֵיכָא); a. e.—Targ. Prov. XXVI, 20 Ar. (ed. הֵיכְנָא).—Ber. 2
<sup>a</sup> תנא ה' קאי וכ' where does the Tannai (of the Mishnah) stand, that he starts with, ‘From what time’?, i.e. to what law does he refer?—Yeb. 106
<sup>a</sup> אבוך ה' where is thy father?—Snh. 93
<sup>a</sup> לה' אזלו where did they go to (what became of them)? Ib. ודניאל לה' אזל where was Daniel at the time?; a. v. fr.—Ḥull. 11
<sup>b</sup> ה' … דלא וכ' (not היכי), v. אֶפְשַׁר. Yoma 2
<sup>b</sup> ה' דליכא דדמי ליה where there is nothing resembling it. B. Mets. 102
<sup>a</sup> כל ה' דאיהו וכ' in all cases in which he can acquire possession himself; a. v. fr.—Emph. הֵיכָן (in Hebr. diction). Pes. 2
<sup>b</sup> וכי ה' מצינו do we find anywhere &c.? Succ. 23
<sup>a</sup> ה' סוכתך where is thy Succah?</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="E00377">
<head-word>הֵיכְדֵין, </head-word>
<head-word>הֵכְ'</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="E00376">preced.</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>even so</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. XVI, 21; a. e. [Targ. II Esth. III, 8 ה'—ה' ed. Lag., oth. ed. ה'—כה' even as—so.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (interrog.) 
<italic>how now?</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 11 (not הַכְּ').</notes></sense>
<sense>
